correctness.rationale: For R(a)=phi(a)v, the identity forces v in the radical and phi(vE+Ev)=0. For projective image in J^2, the annihilator has dimension three; off J^2 it has dimension two, yielding (q^3-1)+(q^2+q)(q^2-1). All algebra automorphisms come from GL2(q) and two socle shifts, and their actions are transitive on the three nonzero (phi(1),phi(J)) support types within each image stratum. Independently recalculated exact six orbit-size polynomials and their totals at q=4,8,16; q=4 total 363 and sizes [3,15,45,60,60,180].
